race_instances.title: DWB kinematic parameters directly accessed across threads
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Issue describes parameter callback and controller thread accessing the same state; owner reviewed and merged PR #1621.
race_instances.trigger_condition: dynamic parameter update overlaps control calculation
race_instances.evidence_summary: Parameter snapshots are published through an atomic pointer.
race_instances.strict_reason: Ordinary parameter fields were concurrently written/read.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: No synchronization before PR #1621.

race_instances.title: DWB atomic raw-pointer reclamation UAF
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: ASan UAF accepted, reviewed and merged in PR #5707.
race_instances.shared_object: atomic raw pointer and pointed KinematicParameters
race_instances.trigger_condition: parameter update deletes snapshot while reader uses it
race_instances.evidence_summary: Merged fix changes the pointer protocol, though immediate delete still appears to lack a reclamation barrier and may be incomplete.
race_instances.strict_reason: Reader use overlaps deletion of the same pointee.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: No reader reclamation guarantee; ASan proves overlap.

race_instances.title: SimpleActionServer future/worker completion race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Issue closed by merged PR #1520; Eloquent backport #1582 is duplicate.
race_instances.trigger_condition: new goal accepted before old worker finishes
race_instances.evidence_summary: Future and worker completion synchronization is reordered.
race_instances.strict_reason: Synchronization/ordering race whose confirmed impact is deadlock, not an unsynchronized memory conflict.

race_instances.title: Navfn costmap copy races map updates
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Maintainer-reviewed merged fix applies existing costmap mutex to copy.
race_instances.trigger_condition: planning copy overlaps map update
race_instances.evidence_summary: Existing costmap mutex now covers array copy.
race_instances.strict_reason: Concurrent buffer read and mutation/reallocation under incomplete locking.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: Read path omitted existing costmap mutex.

race_instances.title: InflationLayer cache/footprint update data race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Owner identified resource locking and specified lock placement; PR #1952 merged.
race_instances.trigger_condition: footprint changes during inflation update
race_instances.evidence_summary: InflationLayer receives a recursive mutex.
race_instances.strict_reason: Concurrent cache/container rebuild and read without locking.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: No common lock before PR #1952.

race_instances.title: BT action old-result/new-goal handle ordering race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Maintainers rejected PR #2305 and merged accepted fix #2356 for the identified race.
race_instances.trigger_condition: old result arrives before new response establishes handle
race_instances.evidence_summary: Goal-result state machine distinguishes old and new goals.
race_instances.strict_reason: Callback ordering/state race without strict memory-conflict evidence.

race_instances.title: FootprintSubscriber shared_ptr replacement UAF
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: ASan UAF accepted; maintainers approved atomic shared_ptr snapshot in PR #2510.
race_instances.trigger_condition: new footprint arrives while reader copies old message
race_instances.evidence_summary: Reader keeps an atomically loaded local shared_ptr snapshot.
race_instances.strict_reason: Reader dereference overlaps callback-driven pointee destruction.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: Plain shared_ptr member was replaced without atomic snapshot.

race_instances.title: LayeredCostmap plugins_ vector races resizeMap
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Merged PR #2512 adds combined-costmap mutex to the distinct addPlugin path.
race_instances.trigger_condition: plugin is added while map resizes
race_instances.evidence_summary: addPlugin uses combined-costmap mutex.
race_instances.strict_reason: Concurrent vector mutation and iteration.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: No common lock before PR #2512.

race_instances.title: VoxelLayer matchSize races initialization/resize
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Merged PR #2513 applies the existing layer mutex.
race_instances.trigger_condition: layer initialization overlaps map resize
race_instances.evidence_summary: Existing layer mutex now covers matchSize.
race_instances.strict_reason: Concurrent buffer resize/access under incomplete locking.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: matchSize omitted existing mutex.

race_instances.title: CostmapSubscriber message shared_ptr replacement UAF
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Merged PR #2530 applies atomic shared_ptr snapshot.
race_instances.trigger_condition: new costmap arrives during conversion
race_instances.evidence_summary: Reader holds an atomic local shared_ptr snapshot.
race_instances.strict_reason: Reader dereference overlaps callback-driven pointee destruction.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: Plain shared_ptr replacement had no synchronization.

race_instances.title: AMCL map replacement races laser callback
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Issue closed by merged PR #2933; developers identify two different mutexes as the synchronization defect.
race_instances.trigger_condition: map replacement overlaps laser processing
race_instances.evidence_summary: Both callback paths use one recursive mutex.
race_instances.strict_reason: Use/free of map/filter state under different mutexes provided no common happens-before.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: Different mutexes on conflicting paths until PR #2933.

race_instances.title: CostmapLayer matchSize races resize
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Maintainer-reviewed PR applies existing mutex to independent base-layer entry point.
race_instances.trigger_condition: base layer matchSize overlaps external resize
race_instances.evidence_summary: Existing layer mutex covers base CostmapLayer matchSize.
race_instances.strict_reason: Concurrent buffer resize/access under incomplete locking.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: matchSize omitted existing mutex.

race_instances.title: Costmap update worker runs before plugin activation
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Merged lifecycle ordering fix gates update loop until activation.
race_instances.trigger_condition: worker starts before plugin activate completes
race_instances.evidence_summary: Update loop runs only when stopped_ is false after activation.
race_instances.strict_reason: Lifecycle call-order race; plugin-specific memory conflicts are not separately proven.

race_instances.title: LayeredCostmap filters_ vector races resizeMap
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: PR explicitly notes earlier plugin fix omitted filters; merged.
race_instances.trigger_condition: filter added while map resizes
race_instances.evidence_summary: Combined costmap mutex now covers addFilter.
race_instances.strict_reason: Concurrent vector mutation and iteration.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: Filter path omitted lock until PR #3518.

race_instances.title: PlannerServer isPathValid reads costmap without lock
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Merged fix applies costmap mutex to service read path.
race_instances.trigger_condition: service scans cells during map update
race_instances.evidence_summary: Existing costmap mutex covers the complete validation read.
race_instances.strict_reason: Concurrent ordinary cell read/write under incomplete locking.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: Service path omitted existing mutex.

race_instances.title: Planner system test resizes costmap while worker uses old buffer
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Maintainer identified test-only race and merged PR #3910.
race_instances.trigger_condition: test replaces map while updater runs
race_instances.evidence_summary: System-test map replacement is synchronized with worker.
race_instances.strict_reason: Worker use overlaps buffer reallocation/free.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: No synchronization before PR #3910.

race_instances.title: AMCL cleanup destroys laser filter before TF listener stops
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: ASan UAF closed by merged PR #4070.
race_instances.trigger_condition: cleanup destroys filter while listener callback is active
race_instances.evidence_summary: TF listener is reset before laser filter.
race_instances.strict_reason: Callback use overlaps resource destruction.
race_instances.memory_location: AMCL laser_scan_filter_ and TF listener target
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: Destruction order allowed active callback before PR #4070.

race_instances.title: Costmap worker survives lifecycle cleanup resource reset
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: ASan and maintainer lifecycle diagnosis closed by merged PR #4385.
race_instances.shared_object: executor_thread_, TF buffer, layered costmap resources
race_instances.trigger_condition: cleanup starts while executor thread continues
race_instances.evidence_summary: Cleanup stops/resets executor thread before other resources.
race_instances.strict_reason: Worker use overlaps resource destruction.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: Worker was not stopped before cleanup reset.

race_instances.title: Dynamic resize callback races costmap update transaction
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Owner-authored and merged fix applies dynamic-parameter mutex to callback and update/publish.
race_instances.shared_object: size, resolution, origin and layered costmap transaction
race_instances.trigger_condition: parameter resize overlaps update/publish
race_instances.evidence_summary: One dynamic-parameter mutex covers both full transactions.
race_instances.strict_reason: Concurrent multi-field/buffer write/read under incomplete locking.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: Update/publish path did not share dynamic-parameter mutex.

race_instances.title: AMCL dynamic reinit races laser callback
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: ASan UAF and callback-group diagnosis closed by merged PR #4397.
race_instances.trigger_condition: reinit overlaps laser processing
race_instances.evidence_summary: Old filter is explicitly reset within coordinated reinit; 18 parameters share this single conflict path.
race_instances.strict_reason: Callback use overlaps filter destruction/replacement.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: Different callback groups did not synchronize old-object use.

race_instances.title: AMCL initial-pose callback can precede delayed map
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Owner accepted root cause and merged PR #4605.
race_instances.trigger_condition: initial pose arrives before first map
race_instances.evidence_summary: Map dimensions are accessed only after first_map_received_.
race_instances.strict_reason: Callback ordering race, not a proven C++ data race.

race_instances.title: Dock database reload races docking action object lifetime
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Merged fix coordinates database reload with docking action.
race_instances.trigger_condition: reload occurs during dock/undock
race_instances.evidence_summary: Database and docking action share a mutex; reload is rejected during action.
race_instances.strict_reason: Object replacement/destruction overlaps action use.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: No common database/action mutex before PR #4574.

race_instances.title: getCosts service reads updating costmap without lock
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Merged fix stabilizes service output by using costmap mutex.
race_instances.trigger_condition: service reads cell during update
race_instances.evidence_summary: Existing costmap mutex covers service read.
race_instances.strict_reason: Concurrent cell read/write under incomplete locking.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: Service callback omitted existing mutex.

race_instances.happens_before_evidence: Affected Humble path lacked scoped locking.

race_instances.evidence_summary: Confirmed problem remains unfixed because replacement PR does not compile as reviewed.
